values./items/0/$overrides/~1system~1descriptio: The synth is a robot. They are immune to the effects of starvation, thirst, and suffocation. They are also immune to Poison and Radiation damage. However, machines cannot use food and drink or other consumables, they do not heal naturally, and the Medicine skill cannot be used to heal them: damage to them must be repaired.
values./items/1/$overrides/~1system~1descriptio: The synth reduces all Poison damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from poison.
values./items/2/$overrides/~1system~1descriptio: The synth reduces all Radiation damage suffered to 0 and cannot suffer any damage or effects from radiation.
values./items/3/$overrides/~1system~1descriptio: The synth cannot be intimidated or threatened in any way and will either ignore or attack anyone who attempts to threaten or intimidate it.
values./items/4/$overrides/~1system~1descriptio: The synth is immune to the effects of all diseases, and they will never suffer the symptoms of any disease.
values./items/6/$overrides/~1system~1effect: Salvaging an incomplete synth yields 2 CD uncommon materials.
values./system/biography: An unfinished first-generation synth found in the Institute compound. It lacks equipment and higher functions but remains a robotic combatant.
